p: One who sees the houses of Israel inhabited … recites:
One who sees the houses of Israel inhabited and tranquil recites:
Blessed…Who establishes the border of the widow. … in ruins he recites:
Blessed…Who establishes the border of the widow. One who sees them in ruins he recites:
the houses of the nations of the world inhabited recites:
“The Lord will destroy the house of the proud, … And … in ruins he recites:
“The Lord will destroy the house of the proud, but He will establish the border of the widow” (Proverbs 15:25). And if he sees them in ruins he recites:
Ulla and Rav Ḥisda were once walking along the road when they came upon the doorway of the house of Rav Ḥana bar Ḥanilai.
Sighing breaks half of one’s body? … As it is stated: … “Sigh, … therefore,
Sighing breaks half of one’s body? As it is stated: “Sigh, therefore,
with the breaking of your loins”
Why are you sighing? … That you shall say: … Because of the tidings,
Why are you sighing? That you shall say: Because of the tidings,
this house where there were sixty cooks during the day and sixty cooks at night who would cook for anyone in need, … and … never removed his hand from his pocket … thought:
this house where there were sixty cooks during the day and sixty cooks at night who would cook for anyone in need, and Rav Ḥana never removed his hand from his pocket because he thought:

until he put his hand in his pocket … would be embarrassed. … Moreover,
until he put his hand in his pocket to give him charity, the poor person would be embarrassed. Moreover,
and anyone who entered hungry left satiated.

anyone who was embarrassed to take

p: From the day that the Temple was destroyed a decree was issued upon the houses of the righteous that they would be destroyed,
“In mine ears said the Lord of hosts:
Of a truth many houses shall be desolate, … even great and fair, … without inhabitant”

They who trust in the Lord are as Mount Zion,
just as in the future the Holy One, … Blessed be He, … will restore Mount Zion to its inhabited state,
just as in the future the Holy One, Blessed be He, will restore Mount Zion to its inhabited state,
in the future the Holy One, … Blessed be He, … will restore the houses of the righteous to their inhabited state,
in the future the Holy One, Blessed be He, will restore the houses of the righteous to their inhabited state,

It is enough for a servant to be like his master.

p: Shmuel raised a contradiction … it is written:
Shmuel raised a contradiction between the implications of two verses with regard to constellations. On the one hand it is written:
and Pleiades, … And … it is written: … “He Who makes Pleiades and Orion”
and Pleiades, and the chambers of the south” (Job 9:9); Orion precedes Pleiades. And on the other hand it is written: “He Who makes Pleiades and Orion”
Were it not for Orion’s heat,
the universe could not exist because of the cold of Pleiades; … were it not for the cold of Pleiades,
the universe could not exist because of the cold of Pleiades; and conversely, were it not for the cold of Pleiades,
the universe could not exist because of the heat of Orion.
